properties.name: Question Difficulty Scoring by Proficiency
properties.description: Estimates a difficulty score for each provided question from the question JSON and a student proficiency level, returning the scores without reranking or rewriting the questions.

properties.name: question_difficulty_estimator
properties.description: Estimates a difficulty score for each recommended question using the question JSON and the student's proficiency level. Returns scores only, without re-ranking or rewriting the questions.
